set system host-name DeviceB.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols bfd interface ge-1/0/0.explanation: Enables the BFD protocol on the specified interface.

bind peer-ip 10.1.1.1.explanation: Configures the IP address of the BFD session.

parameters.name: peer-ip
parameters.explanation: The IP address of the BFD session.

discriminator local 2.explanation: Configure the local identifier for the BFD protocol on the specified interface.

parameters.name: discriminator
parameters.explanation: Local identifier to distinguish between different BFD sessions.

discriminator remote 1.explanation: Configures the remote identifier for BFD sessions.

parameters.name: remote-discriminator
parameters.explanation: A remote identifier for BFD sessions.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 10.1.1.2/24.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.
